standard_prerequisites.name: The chaotic topology and the flatness of j_{U!}O_U
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, the structure of sheaves on a category with chaotic topology: every bounded above complex of O-modules is quasi-isomorphic to one whose terms are direct sums of j_{U!}O_U
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the reduction of the computation to the single sheaves j_{U!}O_U, together with their flatness, which makes tensor with O' exact.

core_obligations: Reduce to bounded above complexes and then to the sheaves j_{U!}O_U (proof lines 10439-10459): L pi_! commutes with colimits, so it suffices to treat bounded above complexes, and each such complex is quasi-isomorphic to a bounded above complex whose terms are direct sums of j_{U!}O_U; in particular the derived tensor product with O' of a flat j_{U!}O_U is its ordinary tensor product.

Set up the simplicial comparison (proof lines 10460-10469): with S_bullet = Mor_C(U_bullet, U) homotopy equivalent to the constant simplicial set on a point, and P_n = O(U_n), P'_n = O'(U_n), the complex of the simplicial abelian group X_bullet with terms the direct sums of P_n over S_n computes L pi_!(j_{U!}O_U).

Compare X_bullet with P_bullet and X'_bullet with P'_bullet (proof lines 10470-10476): both rules are functorial in the simplicial set T_bullet, so the homotopy equivalence S_bullet -> point gives homotopy equivalences X_bullet -> P_bullet and X'_bullet -> P'_bullet of simplicial abelian groups.

Conclude (proof lines 10477-10483): by assumption P_bullet -> P'_bullet is a quasi-isomorphism, since P_bullet and P'_bullet compute L pi_! O and L pi_! O', so X_bullet and X'_bullet are quasi-isomorphic, which is the asserted identity L pi_!(K) = L pi_!(K tensor^L_O O').
proof_roadmap: Reduce to bounded above complexes and then to the sheaves j_{U!}O_U, using that L pi_! commutes with colimits and that flatness makes the derived tensor product ordinary.
Replace the objects by the simplicial abelian groups built from the cosimplicial resolution and the values of O and O'.
Use functoriality in the simplicial set to compare those groups with P_bullet and P'_bullet, and use the assumed quasi-isomorphism to conclude.
difficulty_reason: The lemma computes L pi_! after extension of scalars along a map of sheaves of rings O -> O' on a category with chaotic topology, under the two assumptions of a suitable cosimplicial object and the isomorphism L pi_!O = L pi_!O' (statement lines 10421-10436). The proof (proof lines 10438-10483) reduces to the sheaves j_{U!}O_U, builds the simplicial abelian groups whose associated complexes compute the relevant L pi_!, and uses functoriality in the simplicial set together with the assumed quasi-isomorphism P_bullet -> P'_bullet to deduce that the two complexes are quasi-isomorphic. H2: one reduction and one simplicial comparison, both written out.
